description: Get the evidence on one peptide from its Peptides Academy research dossier, with verbatim quotes from the studies and numbered sources. Without a section it returns the summary and the list of sections; pass a section (for example "human record", "regulatory status", "safety", "mechanism") to read that part in full.

peptide.description: Peptide id or any of its names, for example "bpc157", "semaglutide", "Wegovy" or "GHK-Cu".

section.description: Optional section id or topic from the section list.

name: get_peptide_research
title: Get peptide research
